mintAuthority.summary: USDQ is issuer-minted natively on Ethereum, Polygon, XRPL, and Algorand. Ethereum and Polygon expose independent HadronToken onlyOwner mint paths with 3/5 and 2/5 issuer multisig owners, respectively; both proxy admins are 3/5 multisigs with no detected modules. XRPL issuance is controlled by the USDQ issuer account, while Algorand ASA distribution and role replacement are controlled by the issuer manager/reserve account. The EVM paths remain economically unbounded, and no independent whole-supply reconciliation is verified.

controls.label: USDQ XRPL issuer account
controls.evidence: At validated XRPL ledger 106344095, the official XRPL server returned the Quantoz issuer account rDk1xiArDMjDqnrR2yWypwQAKg4mKnQYvs and gateway_balances reported a USDQ obligation of 1,000,000 units. account_info showed defaultRipple, allowTrustLineClawback, and no SignerList object. The issuer account is the native issued-currency supply authority; no documented multisig policy was present.

controls.label: USDQ Algorand ASA manager/reserve account
controls.capDescription: ASA 2768603795 has a fixed total of 10000000000000000000 base units. The issuer-controlled reserve account controls distribution of that pre-created supply, while the manager can replace reserve, freeze, and clawback role addresses but cannot increase the ASA total after creation.
controls.evidence: At Algorand round 64138559, the official node/indexer returned ASA 2768603795 named Quantoz USDQ (USDQ, six decimals), with manager and creator UALFRIYMF7HTTWPGJCBEKJ2AIROCAQR57SO7ZK7LW2SFXQF6346PSDDU2M and reserve, freeze, and clawback all set to 3PJ3E3D6XI7YWMJAUX6WDCHWZ4GC2WHTAQIWJBYVJ326LM2I6NSMSLGCDY. The ASA total is fixed at 10000000000000000000 base units; the reserve account controls distribution, while the manager can replace role addresses. The manager account is standard signature type, but its off-chain signer custody is not established.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294990 and Polygon block 88323726, the HadronToken deployments expose independent issuer-controlled onlyOwner mint paths, with 3/5 and 2/5 owner multisigs and separate 3/5 proxy-admin multisigs; those proxy admins can replace mint logic. At validated XRPL ledger 106344095, the Quantoz issuer account natively controls the USDQ issued-currency obligation, with no SignerList object present. At Algorand round 64138559, ASA 2768603795 is a native Quantoz USDQ asset with a fixed total, issuer manager, and reserve/freeze/clawback controls; the reserve distributes pre-created supply and the manager can replace role addresses. These four authored deployments are native issuance and are not bridge representations. Quantoz publishes a dated issuer-operated reserve snapshot and DNB supervision, but accessible evidence does not establish a recurring independent whole-supply assets-and-liabilities reconciliation, so reconciliation remains unknown. The EVM direct-mint and upgrade paths remain economically unbounded, and supervision remains prudential.
